title: SessionGateway transcript file, format version 1

format_version.description: The version of this format. It only increases.

event_id.description: The Invintus event ID of the Meeting's recording, as the Recording Log's player link gives it.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the audio file that was transcribed, as 64 lower-case hex digits.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

audio.description: The audio that was transcribed. The audio itself is never kept.

id.description: Identifies the model weights used (name and revision).

model_name.description: The faster-whisper model name, such as small.en.

device.description: The device it ran on, such as cpu or cuda.

compute_type.description: The compute type, such as int8 or float16.

language.description: The language the model was told to expect, such as en.

settings.description: The settings the model ran with.

model.description: The model that made the transcript.

made_at.description: When the transcript was made, as an ISO 8601 time with its offset.

start.description: Second of the audio at which the segment starts.

end.description: Second of the audio at which the segment ends.

avg_logprob.description: faster-whisper's avg_logprob for the segment: the mean log probability of its tokens.

compression_ratio.description: faster-whisper's compression_ratio for the segment: its text's length over its zlib-compressed length.

no_speech_prob.description: faster-whisper's no_speech_prob for the segment: the chance the stretch holds no speech.

temperature.description: faster-whisper's temperature for the segment: the sampling temperature that produced its text.

start.description: Second of the audio at which the word starts.

end.description: Second of the audio at which the word ends.

text.description: The word as the model wrote it, with any leading space and punctuation it carries.

probability.description: The model's probability for the word, when it gives one.

words.description: The segment's words in order. May be empty when the model gave none.

items.description: One stretch of speech the model wrote as a unit.

segments.description: The transcript, in the order of the audio.

description: One Meeting's machine transcript: the contract between the transcription tool and SessionGateway.
